gotchas: English site https://www.jal.co.jp/jp/en/ ; a third-party-data banner at the bottom has a 'Confirmed' button. The page is heavy: the first snapshot can time out and one session's tab died on load, so retry.

Booking widget: tab 'One-way trip', then input[aria-label="From"] / input[aria-label="To"] (visible ones; hidden duplicates exist) - type the IATA code and click the suggestion row; 'Outbound flight date' button opens a two-month calendar, click the day then Confirm; then the red Search button.

Japan domestic HND-ITM works for guests: results list fare buttons named like 'JPY 14,230 One-way Economy Class Seats Available Saver'; after picking one, a 'Proceed as guest' button appears beside 'Log in and continue'.

Customer information (guest): Last name, First name (romaji capitals), 'Age at time of boarding' (input[aria-label*="Age"], a number, not a date of birth), Gender radios, phone type radios (Mobile/Home/Office) + country button + number, email and a confirmation email (the second input with the same placeholder), then Next.
The first Next can answer with a dialog 'The fare has changed. Please return to the seat availability results page and reselect a flight.'; reselect a fare and re-enter the passenger form.

Review page: an agreement checkbox, then 'Purchase (With selecting seats)', 'Purchase (Without selecting seats)' and 'Pay later'. The stepper (Select flights > Enter customer information > Review > Complete booking > Go to purchase) puts 'Complete booking' BEFORE the payment step, so these buttons create the reservation before any card field exists.
